cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Started the Weirdness
cards.instruction: Hide that one casual choice caused the impossible situation while eagerly helping manage each new consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The cups are floating. I'll tie them down while you rescue breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You flicked that gravity switch reaching for the toaster.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Could've been the toaster. Give me the string; I'll secure everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole table's rising. Hold my ankles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got you. I'll anchor us to the radiator. Let's list what floated, not who touched what.

mechanism: A copies a switch action without understanding it, causes floating breakfast, then offers energetic help while deflecting causal responsibility.
confusable: D157 hides own casual cause while helping; D133 redirects clues without requiring impossible consequences or eager help.
seedUse: Keep B explicit cause and rising-table consequence answered by actual assistance.
